newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Germany committed to 180 Eurofighters - Ruehe.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Germany committed to 180 Eurofighters - Ruehe.

text.p: Germany had a very firm commitment to buying 180 Eurofighter 2000 aircraft, Defence Minister Volker Ruehe said on Tuesday.
Asked to describe Germany's commitment to that number of fighters, Ruehe told reporters: "Very firm but difficult to find the money."

Germany plans to buy 140 Eurofighters as fighters and another 40 as attack aircraft. Britain requires 232 units from the multi-national project, Italy is scheduled to take 140 and Spain said last Friday it would buy 87.
The Times of London, referring to remarks Ruehe had made in India last week, said Germany now intended to buy just 140 aircraft from the programme.
Ruehe also said Tuesday he expected no change in the industrial distribution of the programme between its partners.
The project is shared unequally between British Aerospace Plc, the DASA unit of Germany's Daimler-Benz AG, Alenia SpA of Italy and Spain's CASA.
Ruehe is in Australia for talks with the Australian government.
